title: Manipur: Over 35,000 tribal students await pending scholarships

ai.summary: Over 35,000 tribal students in Manipur staged a protest demanding release of pending scholarships for the 2025-26 academic year after the government failed to disburse funds despite sanctions in April 2026.

facts.claim: Over 35,000 tribal students staged a protest
facts.quote: More than 35,000 tribal students remain deprived of the scholarship
the ST scholarship was sanctioned in April this year
the student union had written to the Director of the Tribal Affairs and Hills Department, demanding the release of the pending scholarship amount by November 15, 2026.

ai.background_note: Tribal students in Manipur have repeatedly staged protests for scholarship disbursement, with delays becoming a routine issue.
